verdict.rationale: Pigment documents first-party built-in agents that take delegated work. The Modeler Agent builds, maintains and optimizes planning models from natural-language intent, and the Analyst Agent monitors the business and builds reports from conversations. Agent Connectors let these agents pull context from Notion, Google Drive and Slack. The MCP-server items describe external assistants rather than a built-in one, so they were not credited here. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how delegation works inside the product UI (scope, review/approval of agent actions), and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond one-line marketing claims.
